name: Block Me, I Dare You
source:
The dynamic between Rafael and Noah is filled with banter, reluctant connection, and slow-building tension. Despite Noah’s resistance, Rafael persistently inserts himself into Noah's life with charm, chaos, and unexpected gestures. Despite Rafael's persistence annoys Noah, it also leads to heartwarming and endearing moments.

[Edited from [url=https://kyuroun.itch.io/block-me-i-dare-you]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
拉斐尔和诺亚之间的动态充满了玩笑、勉强的联系和缓慢形成的紧张气氛。尽管诺亚极力抵制，拉斐尔仍坚持以魅力、混乱和意想不到的姿态融入诺亚的生活。尽管拉斐尔的坚持惹恼了诺亚，但这也带来了温馨可爱的时刻。

[编辑自[url=https://kyuroun.itch.io/block-me-i-dare-you]Itch.io[/url]]
